# Data Model Thomas Rentmeister (Q139288222)

The data model of the exhibition **“Thomas Rentmeister” (Q139288222)** is based on Wikidata and is compared with established metadata standards.

The Wikidata item describes an art exhibition by Thomas Rentmeister at the Sprengel Museum Hannover in 2024.

## Mapping Wikidata → Standards

| Wikidata property | Meaning | Dublin Core | Schema.org | CIDOC CRM |
|-------------------|---------|-------------|------------|-----------|
| instance of (P31) | Exhibition | dc:type | Event | E7 Activity |
| title (P1476) | Title of the exhibition | dc:title | name | E41 Appellation |
| location (P276) | Sprengel Museum Hannover | dc:coverage | location | E53 Place |
| main subject (P921) | Thomas Rentmeister | dc:subject | about | E21 Person |
| start time (P580) | September 2024 | dc:date | startDate | E52 Time-Span |
| end time (P582) | November 2024 | dc:date | endDate | E52 Time-Span |
| official website (P856) | Website of the exhibition | dc:identifier | url | E42 Identifier |
| language (P407) | German | dc:language | inLanguage | E56 Language |

## Description of the Standards

### Wikidata

Wikidata serves as the starting point for the data model. The exhibition is represented by the item **Q139288222**.

The item contains structured information about the exhibition title, the Sprengel Museum Hannover as its location, Thomas Rentmeister as its main subject, the exhibition period, the official website and the German language.

### Dublin Core

Dublin Core is a widely used metadata standard for describing digital and cultural resources. It uses basic elements such as title, type, subject, date, language, coverage and identifier.

In this data model, `dc:title` represents the title of the exhibition, `dc:coverage` represents its location and `dc:subject` represents Thomas Rentmeister as the main subject.

### Schema.org

Schema.org provides structured metadata for websites and search engines. The exhibition can be represented as an `Event`.

The properties `name`, `location`, `about`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `url` and `inLanguage` can be used to describe the exhibition on a website.

### CIDOC CRM

CIDOC CRM is an international standard for documenting cultural heritage information.

The exhibition can be represented as an `E7 Activity`. Its title is represented as an `E41 Appellation`, the Sprengel Museum Hannover as an `E53 Place`, Thomas Rentmeister as an `E21 Person` and the exhibition period as an `E52 Time-Span`.

## Conclusion

The mapping demonstrates how the Wikidata properties of the **Thomas Rentmeister exhibition** correspond to Dublin Core, Schema.org and CIDOC CRM.

Using these standards improves interoperability and makes the exhibition data easier to understand, exchange and reuse across websites, museums and other cultural heritage information systems.
